name: Molten Orbit
description: Demo: a raymarched torus and orbiting sphere melting together, built entirely through the PatchToy MCP server. Tweak it in the Parameters panel (P): Shape, Motion, Colour and Music.

data.text:
# Molten Orbit
A raymarched torus and an orbiting sphere melt into each other over a tiled floor, under a synthwave sun.
Reacts to music: open the audio menu → Mic (the sphere swells on the kick, the grid flares on the beat).
## Tweak it in the Parameters panel
Press P (or the sliders button in the top bar): Shape, Motion, Colour and Music settings with pretty names; hover a name for what it does, double-click a slider to reset it.
Double-click a group box to open it, Esc to come back.

## Scene SDF
One signed distance function: torus ∪ orbiting sphere with a smooth union (k = melt), displaced by 3D Perlin noise, plus a floor plane. Raymarch walks each ray until this distance is ~0.

## Material / Shading
Lambert + Blinn-Phong lighting, a cosine-palette iridescence driven by Fresnel and height, and a procedural tile pattern for the floor. A step on the hit height picks floor or object.

## Environment
What rays that miss see: a vertical sky gradient, a striped retro sun drawn in screen space, and a distance-fog mask that fades surfaces into it.

## Composite & Post FX
Surfaces are mixed into the environment by the fog mask, then ACES tonemapping, saturation, vignette and film grain.

## Music
Audio level gates everything: with the audio off or silent, drive = 0 and the piece looks exactly as before. drive = music × smoothstep(level).
- Kick: the orbiting sphere swells (radius 0.55 → 0.68) and the molten noise churns harder (×1.6).
- Bass: the melt radius breathes up to +30%, so torus and sphere fuse more.
- Beat (attack-decay envelope): the floor grid lines flare (×2.4) and the iridescent rim brightens.
Beat-phase couplings (grid flare, rim brighten) are also multiplied by the beat tracker's confidence (Beat.confidence = u_beatConfidence: 0 with the audio off, ~1 once the beat locks, 1 with the metronome) and run on the stable beat clock with its certainty gate (Beat.gate / BeatEnvelope gate: fade, u_beatTrust): after a track change the clock holds the old tempo, then glides to the new one without jumps, and these couplings fade out until the new beat is trusted. Level and band couplings (kick swell, molten churn, bass melt) are not.

data.label: Torus spin
data.description: Rotation speed of the torus (radians per second).

data.label: Melt
data.description: Smooth-union radius: how much the torus and the sphere fuse.

data.label: Orbit speed
data.description: How fast the camera circles the scene.

data.label: Camera distance
data.description: Distance from the camera to the centre.

data.label: Tile colour
data.description: Base colour of the floor tiles.

data.label: Fog
data.description: Distance fog density (fades surfaces into the sky).

data.label: Rim glow
data.description: Brightness of the iridescent Fresnel rim.

data.label: Grid colour
data.description: Neon colour of the floor grid lines.

data.label: Grid glow
data.description: Brightness of the neon floor grid.

data.label: Noise flow
data.description: How fast the molten noise churns.

data.label: Molten noise
data.description: Amount of 3D Perlin displacement on the surface.

data.label: Sun bottom
data.description: Colour of the lower half of the retro sun.

data.label: Sun top
data.description: Colour of the upper half of the retro sun.

data.label: Sun brightness
data.description: HDR intensity of the retro sun.

data.label: Music reactivity
data.description: 0 = ignore the music. Sphere swells on the kick, melt breathes on the bass, grid flares on the beat.
